[[File:Vengeful_Ones_mind_prison.png|thumb|The Mind Prison]]
The '''Vengeful One's mind prison''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Mind prison]] in which the [[Vengeful One]] was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Breeder]]. It was kept in [[the Tomb]] and was accessed by an operative of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|The Bigger They Are|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>
